stem.text: An airport has a mechanical system for moving luggage. The system uses a horizontal conveyor belt, a sloping conveyor belt, a lift and a frictionless slide. A suitcase is moved around the airport using this system.

stem.alt: Side view of the luggage system: a sloping conveyor belt labelled 8 m, a horizontal conveyor belt labelled 16 m, a lift labelled 10 m, and a sloping slide labelled 12 m ending at a trolley. Suitcases are drawn on each part.

stem.text: Resistive forces opposing the motion of the suitcase are negligible.
For which movement of the suitcase is the net work done on the suitcase greatest?

A.text: moving the suitcase a distance of $8\,\text{m}$ at a constant speed up the sloping conveyor belt

B.text: moving the suitcase a distance of $16\,\text{m}$ at a constant speed along the horizontal conveyor belt

C.text: moving the suitcase a distance of $10\,\text{m}$ at a constant speed vertically upwards on the lift

D.text: moving the suitcase a distance of $12\,\text{m}$ at increasing speed downwards on the slide
